annotation.title_clean: ASTM F3389/F3389M-21 Standard Test Method for Assessing the Safety of Small Unmanned Aircraft Impacts
annotation.title_en: ASTM F3389/F3389M-21 Standard Test Method for Assessing the Safety of Small Unmanned Aircraft Impacts
annotation.venue: ASTM International Book of Standards Vol. 15.09
annotation.summary_en: ASTM standard test method (store page excerpt) for assessing blunt-force injury potential when small unmanned aircraft (under 55 lbf) impact people on the ground. It offers four methods (A–D) to support civil aviation authority approval of flight over people, based on FAA ASSURE research.
key_provisions_or_claims: Four methods (A–D) assess sUA impact injury potential: analytical, simplified test, full ATD test, and energy-based comparison.
Method A verifies impact kinetic energy does not exceed 54 ft-lbf for FAA Category 2/3 operations.
Applies to sUA under 55 lbf per 14 CFR 107.3.
Results support, but do not replace, the governing CAA's approval decision for flight over people.
Based on FAA/ASSURE research and automotive injury metrics; supplements ASTM F3298, F3322 and F2910.
